## Summary

Briefly describe the skill or change being added.

- **Skill name:**
- **Category:** core / domain
- **Target user:** (e.g. data engineer, analytics engineer, BI developer)

---

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the standard skill structure (`SKILL.md`, `README.md`, `example-input.md`, `example-output.md`)
- [ ] Placed in the correct folder (`skills/core/` or `skills/domain/<domain>/`)
- [ ] Folder name is lowercase and hyphen-separated
- [ ] Includes at least one realistic worked example
- [ ] Examples use generic, public-safe content (no company names, internal systems, or sensitive data)
- [ ] Guiding principles are specific and opinionated, not generic best-practice lists
- [ ] Output format section defines a consistent, predictable structure
- [ ] Avoid section captures at least two common failure modes
- [ ] `README.md` is short and navigational — full skill content is in `SKILL.md` only
- [ ] Australian/British English spelling used where applicable (modelling, standardisation, etc.)

---

## Notes for reviewers

Any context that would help the reviewer understand design decisions or trade-offs made in this skill.
